Historical full-card image of [[Through The Force Things You Will See (V) (Virtual Set 13: Remote Outpost) (Original)|Through The Force Things You Will See]], matching the [[Virtual Set 13: Remote Outpost]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.
